Entry 7: Pilot Index Part 1: Kleopatra
Full name: Kleopatra Perpetua Megalou (born Kleopatra Psychí Megalou)
Known as: Kleopatra, Kleo
Height: 9' 11" (302.26 centimeters)
Weight: 500 pounds (226.8 kilograms)
Birthplace: Néa Athína, Greece, Mars
Residence Prior to Wartime: Athens, Greece, Earth
Residence Now: Venus Base 1
Parents (Alive or Dead): Menelaos Megalos and Eleni Megalou
Marital Status: Widowed
Spouse(s) (Alive or Dead): Ioulios Pappas (known as Ioulios)
Parents-in-Law (Alive or Dead): Theodoulos Pappas and Dorothea Pappa
Number of Children (Alive or Dead): 4
Job Ranking: 3/1000
Reasons for Ranking: She has shown to be amazing at piloting robots. 
She always gets missions done way before their due dates, she has excellent skill in piloting, 
has shown to be a woman of intellegence, has shown to be crafty, is friendly to everyone, 
and always listens to her upper ranking peers.
She only has a problem with doing other things that aren't her job, 
but even when doing that she can be helpful. She also isn't the best robot pilot, but she's for sure up there.
Comments:
Private Johnmark Petit: "She is for sure helpful! There was this one time I got stuck underneath an automatic
door, and she just kicked the door down instantously with just a single kick. 
She is so awesome and strong, but that's just my opinion! 
she reminds me of my mother for some reason in a good way."
Private Patrick Petit: "Congrats Kleo for getting a 3/1000 ranking! She deserves it!"
Specialist Uther Falconer: "I don't see how she is intellgent, given that she had no idea what being genderfluid is,
but I respect her somewhat."
Sergeant Sérgio Silveira: "I can see her being helpful. She tried helping me with defending the base with the guns on the roof.
She sort of succeded, but she just got lucky. I appreciated the help though.
She also is pretty much a mother to Private Patrick and Private Perry, which is cool. 
They're too innocent to be fighting alone without some sort of parental figure."
